content.unit.simit.name: Bagel
content.unit.simit.flavor: One ring, one morning. Throw it — it comes back.
content.unit.manti.name: Dumpling
content.unit.manti.flavor: Forty fit on one spoon. One is enough for you.
content.unit.pide.name: Flatcake
content.unit.borek.name: Strudel
content.unit.borek.flavor: Forty layers. Every punch takes one, never all.
content.unit.misir.name: Popcorn
content.unit.misir.flavor: Throws its kernel. Pops when it heats up.
content.unit.kestane.name: Chestnut
content.unit.kestane.flavor: Wait for the shell to crack. Then run.
content.unit.sis.name: Skewer
content.unit.sis.flavor: Turns and turns over the fire — one day, it comes down.
content.unit.kofte.name: Meatball
content.unit.kofte.flavor: Kneaded by hand, hardened by fire. You’re next.
content.unit.aycicegi.name: Sunbloom
content.unit.aycicegi.flavor: Follows the sun. You’d better be watched too.
content.unit.bamya.name: Okra
content.unit.bamya.flavor: Small, green, and nobody’s favorite. It knows.
content.unit.kabak.name: Squash
content.unit.patlican.name: Eggplant
content.unit.patlican.flavor: Held up over coals, held up in the pan. Used to a punch.
content.unit.nar.name: Garnet
content.unit.nar.flavor: The moment you open it, everything scatters. Seed by seed.
content.unit.zeytin.name: Olive
content.unit.zeytin.flavor: Small and black. Bite once and you’ll understand.
content.unit.karpuz.name: Melon
content.unit.karpuz.flavor: Heaviest thing in the Garden. You can’t lift it — don’t try.
content.unit.pastirma.name: Pastrami
content.unit.pastirma.flavor: Thick-cured, long-cured. Sold by the kilo, strikes by the slice.
content.unit.cay.name: Tea
content.unit.cay.flavor: Slim glass, thin waist. Comes hot, goes hot.
content.unit.kahve.name: Coffee
content.unit.kahve.flavor: Owed forty years of gratitude. Something’s written in the grounds, too.
content.unit.lokum.name: Delight
content.unit.lokum.flavor: Soft. The more you hit it, the deeper you sink.
content.unit.dondurma.name: Sundae
content.unit.dondurma.flavor: Made by being churned, over and over. So will you be.
content.unit.sirke.name: Vinegar
content.unit.sirke.flavor: Made by souring. With patience, and a little spite.
content.unit.tursu.name: Pickle
content.unit.tursu.flavor: Waited in the brine. Your move.
content.unit.kuflupeynir.name: Stilton
content.unit.kuflupeynir.flavor: Mold isn’t a flaw. This time, it’s a plan.
content.unit.tarhana.name: Cracker
content.unit.tarhana.flavor: Already cracked, already dried. What more can you do to it?
content.unit.balkavanozu.name: Honey Jar
content.unit.korkuluk.name: Scarecrow
content.unit.korkuluk.flavor: It guards the patch. The birds already know — you’ll learn.
content.unit.kurum.name: Soot
content.unit.kurum.flavor: You thought you wiped it off. It’s on your finger.
content.unit.kor.name: Ember
content.unit.kor.flavor: Don’t call the fire out. It’s waiting under the ash.
content.unit.duman.name: Smoke
content.unit.duman.flavor: Shut the door. It comes down the chimney.
content.unit.komur.name: Charcoal
content.unit.komur.flavor: It hasn’t finished burning. It is only waiting.
content.unit.curuf.name: Clinker
content.unit.curuf.flavor: What sets at the bottom of the oven. It takes steel to scrape off.
content.unit.kul.name: Ash
content.unit.kul.flavor: Sweep it and it rises. Leave it and it settles on the bread.
content.unit.cira.name: Kindling
content.unit.cira.flavor: Split thin and full of resin. It was made to catch.
content.unit.sac.name: Griddle
content.unit.sac.flavor: Hot on both faces. Nobody remembers which one they touched.
content.unit.zifir.name: Tar
content.unit.zifir.flavor: It ran down the flue for years. Now it walks.
content.unit.masa.name: Tongs
content.unit.masa.flavor: Made to reach into the fire. It never learned to let go.
content.unit.kavruk.name: Scorch
content.unit.kavruk.flavor: Left in too long. The cracks are where the heat got out.
content.unit.yaniksomun.name: Burnt Loaf
content.unit.yaniksomun.flavor: Someone shut the door on it. It rose anyway.
content.unit.bit.name: Aphid
content.unit.bit.flavor: One is nothing. A hundred is a sack.
content.unit.akar.name: Flour Mite
content.unit.akar.flavor: You sifted the flour. The flour sifted you.
content.unit.kurtcuk.name: Grub
content.unit.kurtcuk.flavor: A small mouth. It never stops.
content.unit.guve.name: Pantry Moth
content.unit.guve.flavor: You opened the cupboard and dust rose. It was not dust.
content.unit.karinca.name: Ant
content.unit.karinca.flavor: If you have seen one, you are already late.
content.unit.orumcek.name: Spider
content.unit.orumcek.flavor: It took the corner. You pay the rent.
content.unit.tirtil.name: Caterpillar
content.unit.tirtil.flavor: It finished the leaf. The crate is next.
content.unit.hamambocegi.name: Cockroach
content.unit.hamambocegi.flavor: You turned the light on. You saw one of them.
content.unit.ambarbiti.name: Granary Weevil
content.unit.ambarbiti.flavor: Born in the sack. Never once left it.
content.unit.salyangoz.name: Snail
content.unit.salyangoz.flavor: In no hurry. It is already inside the crate.
content.unit.kurtlulahana.name: Wormy Cabbage
content.unit.kurtlulahana.flavor: Firm on the outside. Do not count the leaves.
content.unit.curukpatates.name: Rotten Potato
content.unit.curukpatates.flavor: It was at the bottom of the crate. The crate is its now.
content.unit.pas.name: Rust
content.unit.pas.flavor: The cupboard stayed shut. The metal did the rest.
content.unit.teneke.name: Tin
content.unit.teneke.flavor: Do not grab it. The grip stays with you.
content.unit.capak.name: Burr
content.unit.capak.flavor: The piece that fell off the cut. Still sharp.
content.unit.tel.name: Wire
content.unit.tel.flavor: It reaches from behind the shelf. You never see the end.
content.unit.civi.name: Nail
content.unit.civi.flavor: It was holding something. Not any more.
content.unit.kapak.name: Lid
content.unit.kapak.flavor: It was made to close. Now it closes on its own.
content.unit.mentese.name: Hinge
content.unit.mentese.flavor: It swings both ways. Neither is yours.
content.unit.vida.name: Screw
content.unit.vida.flavor: It worked loose and came out. It never stopped turning.
content.unit.lehim.name: Solder
content.unit.lehim.flavor: Left over from a repair. The repaired thing is gone.
content.unit.tortu.name: Scale
content.unit.tortu.flavor: Everything that settled. It settled for years.
content.unit.sismiskonserve.name: Swollen Can
content.unit.sismiskonserve.flavor: The lid has risen. Nobody tried to open it.
content.unit.eksitursu.name: Soured Pickle
content.unit.eksitursu.flavor: The jar held. What was in it did not.
content.unit.kopuk.name: Foam
content.unit.kopuk.flavor: White all over the top. No telling what is under it.
content.unit.kir.name: Grime
content.unit.kir.flavor: A little more each day. Nobody remembers the first one.
content.unit.damla.name: Drip
content.unit.damla.flavor: The tap is off. The drip comes anyway.
content.unit.kirec.name: Limescale
content.unit.kirec.flavor: What the water left. The water is gone.
content.unit.lif.name: Scourer
content.unit.lif.flavor: It was meant to clean. It learned scratching better.
content.unit.sunger.name: Sponge
content.unit.sunger.flavor: Everything it soaked up is still in there. Do not squeeze.
content.unit.leke.name: Stain
content.unit.leke.flavor: Scrubbed three times. Back all three.
content.unit.buhar.name: Steam
content.unit.buhar.flavor: You cannot hold it. It burns anyway.
content.unit.sabun.name: Soap
content.unit.sabun.flavor: It slips the hand. It lands by your foot.
content.unit.bulasik.name: Dishes
content.unit.bulasik.flavor: Last night's pile. By morning it stands on its own.
content.unit.kireclimusluk.name: Limed Tap
content.unit.kireclimusluk.flavor: It will not shut. Nobody is trying to shut it.
content.unit.camasirsuyu.name: Bleach
content.unit.camasirsuyu.flavor: It takes the stain out. And more than the stain.
content.unit.nem.name: Damp
content.unit.nem.flavor: It stands in the wall. It gets into the shelf.
content.unit.yosun.name: Moss
content.unit.yosun.flavor: It takes hold of stone. It does not let go.
content.unit.sizinti.name: Seep
content.unit.sizinti.flavor: No telling where it came from. Plain where it went.
content.unit.mantar.name: Mushroom
content.unit.mantar.flavor: It grows in the dark. It never asks for light.
content.unit.islaklik.name: Wetness
content.unit.islaklik.flavor: Wiped dry. Back within the hour.
content.unit.mildiyo.name: Mildew
content.unit.mildiyo.flavor: A thin veil. What was under it is gone.
content.unit.curuk.name: Rot
content.unit.curuk.flavor: It started in one place. It wanted all of it.
content.unit.akinti.name: Trickle
content.unit.akinti.flavor: It goes slowly. It never stops.
content.unit.salamura.name: Brine
content.unit.salamura.flavor: Put down to last the winter. The winter passed.
content.unit.rutubet.name: Humidity
content.unit.rutubet.flavor: You shut the door. It stayed inside.
content.unit.nemlicuval.name: Damp Sack
content.unit.nemlicuval.flavor: The mouth was tied. It was not enough.
content.unit.kokusmusfici.name: Rank Barrel
content.unit.kokusmusfici.flavor: It was at the very bottom. It is what is left.
content.origin.hamur.name: Dough
content.origin.hamur.description: Dough divides. It multiplies as you win.
content.origin.ocak.name: Hearth
content.origin.ocak.description: The hearth cooks. Raw goes in, seared comes out.
content.origin.bostan.name: Garden
content.origin.bostan.description: The garden grows. And the garden has a guardian.
content.origin.pazar.name: Market
content.origin.pazar.description: The market knows its accounts. Every fallen body has a price.
content.origin.ikram.name: Treat
content.origin.ikram.description: A treat can’t be refused. One plate, one fewer enemy.
content.origin.kuf.name: Mold
content.origin.kuf.description: Mold spreads. Standing close together is a bad idea.
content.role.nisanci.name: Marksman
content.role.nisanci.description: The marksman warms up. Every hit speeds up the next.
content.role.suikastci.name: Assassin
content.role.suikastci.description: The assassin finishes. It sees the wounded and ends it.
content.role.oncu.name: Vanguard
content.role.oncu.description: The vanguard stands in front. Shield goes first, then health.
content.role.dovuscu.name: Brawler
content.role.dovuscu.description: The brawler heats up. Unbreakable, and tougher the lower its health.
